projects.title: Van Name Generator
projects.description: Name the van with your favorite tool and the street you grew up on.
projects.howToPlay: It asks for a tool, then a street. Press Go after each answer.

projects.title: Job Split Calculator
projects.description: Split a job's total, with tax, across the crew.
projects.howToPlay: Enter the job total, the tax percent, and how many people are splitting it.

projects.title: Leak Triage Bot
projects.description: Decide if a leak is an emergency, then what to do next.
projects.howToPlay: Answer yes or no. Capital letters are fine.

projects.title: Fitting Rock Paper Scissors
projects.description: Wrench, pipe, plunger. Can you beat the computer?
projects.howToPlay: Type wrench, pipe, or plunger. Wrench beats pipe, pipe beats plunger, plunger beats wrench.

projects.title: Parts Order Builder (In Order)
projects.description: Build a parts order code: letters, then numbers, then symbols.
projects.howToPlay: Three whole numbers: how many letters, how many numbers, how many symbols.

projects.title: Parts Order Builder (Shuffled)
projects.description: Build a parts order code, then shuffle the pieces.
projects.howToPlay: Same three questions as the in-order version. This one mixes the code up.

projects.title: Drain Snake Simulator
projects.description: Snake a drain. Push toward the clog, then twist.
projects.howToPlay: Type push to move one foot, or twist to try the clog. The clog is 1 to 10 feet away.

projects.title: Guess the Fitting
projects.description: Guess the secret plumbing fitting, one letter at a time.
projects.howToPlay: Type one letter at a time. A wrong letter costs a life. You start with 6.

projects.title: Secret Work Order Code
projects.description: Encode or decode a plumbing work order with a Caesar cipher.
projects.howToPlay: Type encode or decode, then the message, then a shift number. Type no when it asks if you want to go again.

projects.title: Contractor Bid Board
projects.description: Collect contractor bids, then see who offered the most.
projects.howToPlay: Type a name, then a whole-number bid. Type yes for another contractor, or no to see the winner.

projects.title: Plumbing Job Estimator
projects.description: A full job estimate that uses a skill from every day so far.
projects.howToPlay: Type a customer name, then how many feet of pipe. Type y to do another, or n to finish.
